POSE 1: ISSUE - Arms detached from torso, legs too thin, no balance point.
POSE 2: OK - Natural crouch, feet grounded, spine curved correctly.
POSE 3: ISSUE - Floating leg, disjointed limbs, unnatural balance.
POSE 4: ISSUE - Knee joint misaligned, foot placement awkward.
POSE 5: OK - Dynamic stride, limbs proportional, good weight shift.
POSE 6: OK - Symmetrical jump, arms and legs coordinated.
